Public Works Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
GOVERNMENT CLIENT · Tamil Nadu · IN
REFERENCE LETTER
To Whomsoever It May Concern
Ref: REF/1/80
Date: 31 Mar 2026
To Whomsoever It May Concern,
This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said agency has executed work for this
organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found satisfactory.
1. PROJECT DETAILS
Project Name
Canal Lining — Tamil Nadu Pkg-90
Scope of Work
Irrigation works for Public Works Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu completed 2014.
Nature of Work
Irrigation
Contract Value
Rs. 2609.00 Lakh
Date of Completion
2014-06-20
Contractor's Role
Prime
2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT
Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was professional, though correspondence on variations was occasionally slow, and .
On that basis the agency would be considered favourably for similar assignments.
Criterion
Rating
Observation
Adherence to Schedule
Excellent
Project delivered within contractual timeline
Quality of Work
Excellent
Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications
Safety Record
Good
BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout
Responsiveness
Excellent
Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs
Financial Integrity
Good
Billing was accurate and supported by records
3. RECOMMENDATION
We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our satisfaction. Their performance on schedule,
quality, and safety was commendable.
We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in the future. This reference is valid
for a period of High from the date of this letter.
4. VERIFICATION
For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter is issued upon specific request of the
contractor and does not constitute any commitment or guarantee for future engagements.
